summary: Comprehensive testing of new features (Iteration 4) completed. Backend: 28/28 tests passed (100%). Frontend: Tasmee history table verified with all required columns. Found 1 BUG: Duplicate endpoint definition for PUT /sheikh/students/{id} allows admin access when it should be sheikh-only.

critical.issue: DUPLICATE ENDPOINT DEFINITION - Line 2816 allows both sheikh AND admin, Line 6052 (sheikh-only with audit log) is never reached. Admin can update students via this endpoint when requirements specify sheikh-only.
critical.fix: Remove duplicate at line 2816-2879 or merge functionality into single endpoint at line 6052

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: Remove duplicate PUT /sheikh/students/{student_id} endpoint at lines 2816-2879 in server.py. Keep only the version at lines 6052-6086 which has proper sheikh-only RBAC and audit logging.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate endpoint definition: PUT /sheikh/students/{student_id} defined twice (lines 2816 and 6052). First definition allows admin+sheikh, second (never reached) is sheikh-only with audit log.
The second definition at line 6052 has the correct implementation per requirements (sheikh-only + audit log) but is shadowed by the first definition.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new APIs working correctly except for the duplicate endpoint bug. Tested: POST /api/admin/terms/reset (admin-only), POST /api/badges/types (admin-only), POST /api/badges/assign (sheikh-only - admin correctly gets 403), DELETE /api/badges/remove (sheikh-only), PUT /api/sheikh/students/{id} (BUG: admin can access), GET /api/students/{id}/tasmee-history, GET /api/audit-logs (admin-only). Frontend tasmee history table shows: التاريخ, حفظ جديد, مراجعة, الحالة columns correctly.

features_tested.POST /api/admin/terms/reset: PASSED - Admin only, resets term correctly
features_tested.POST /api/badges/types: PASSED - Admin only can create badge types
features_tested.PUT /api/sheikh/students/{id}: BUG - Admin can access (should be sheikh-only)
features_tested.GET /api/students/{id}/tasmee-history: PASSED - Returns history with date, new_pages, review_pages
features_tested.Frontend tasmee history table: PASSED - Shows التاريخ, حفظ جديد, مراجعة, الحالة columns

rca_of_issue.issue: PUT /api/sheikh/students/{student_id} allows admin access when it should be sheikh-only
rca_of_issue.root_cause: Duplicate endpoint definition in server.py. First definition at line 2816 allows both sheikh AND admin roles. Second definition at line 6052 (sheikh-only with audit log) is never reached because FastAPI uses the first matching route.
reproduction_steps: 2. Call PUT /api/sheikh/students/{student_id} with any update data
rca_of_issue.mitigation: Remove the duplicate endpoint definition at lines 2816-2879 and keep only the correct implementation at lines 6052-6086 which has proper sheikh-only RBAC and audit logging.
